description: Parking — Stations is a dataset listed in Brisbane Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. Number of vacant spaces at Brisbane City Council’s 2 parking stations. Brisbane City Council operates two car parks in the Brisbane Central Business District (CBD) at King George Square and Wickham Terrace. Both car parks operate with extended hours throughout the year and are open on most public holidays and during some special events. Coverage: Brisbane, Queensland. The portal files it under Transport, Parking and Walking. Its keywords are api, motor vehicle, parking, transport, travel. The portal shows 1 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-brisbane-qld-gov-au-portal.
